company: China Gold International Resources Corp. Ltd.

mines.mine_notes: 2025: copper produced 70,883 t (156.3M lbs, exceeding 63,000-67,000 t guidance); gold 80,409 oz (guidance 69,124-73,947 oz); silver 5,645,915 oz; lead 40,912 t; zinc 23,446 t; moly 768 t. Ore processed 11.84 Mt at 0.71% Cu (84% recovery), 0.29 g/t Au (73% recovery), 21.15 g/t Ag (70% recovery). Costs disclosed per pound of copper, not per ounce of gold, and no AISC: total production cost US$3.52/lb (US$0.52/lb after by-product credits); cash production cost US$2.74/lb (US$-0.26/lb after by-product credits, i.e. by-product credits exceeded cash cost). Operations suspended in 2023 after Guolanggou tailings overflow; resumption approved May 30, 2024; stable operation restored in 2024. Long-term plan: Phase II plant at 34,000 tpd; permitted capacity increase toward 50,000 tpd being pursued with underground resource integration.
mines.processing: Open-pit and underground; Phase I (6,000 tpd, since 2010) + Phase II (44,000 tpd, since 2018); combined design capacity 50,000 tpd

mines.mine_notes: 96.5% via Inner Mongolia Pacific Mining Co. Ltd (JV with Ningxia Nuclear Industry Geological Exploration Institution). 2025: ore placed on pad 10.30 Mt at 0.49 g/t; gold produced 96,816 oz (exceeding 77,162-83,592 oz guidance), sold 99,010 oz. Cash production cost US$1,263/oz (total cost of sales US$164.9M less depreciation/depletion); AISC not disclosed. Design 60,000 tpd, reduced to 40,000 tpd per 2019 optimized mine plan; open pit nearing end of mine life, slope stability the priority; underground block-caving potential under evaluation. Project-to-date gold recovery ~56.6%.
mines.processing: Open-pit heap leach with cyanide solution; electro-won gold doré sold to refiners; two low-grade near-surface deposits (Northeast Zone, Southwest Zone)

notes: Source: 2025 Results Announcement (HKEX; mirror PDF from companiesmarketcap.com — HKEX source page not captured at download time). FY2025: revenue US$1,310.1M (+73% YoY), net profit US$472.3M (+623%), operating cash flow US$710.0M; declared ordinary and special dividend. Total gold produced 177,225 oz (+9%); copper 70,883 t. No AISC disclosed: cash production costs disclosed (CSH US$1,263/oz gold; Jiama costs reported per pound of copper). Controlled by China National Gold Group (state-owned). Listed on HKEX and TSX (CGG). 2026 capex/expansion plan centres on Jiama Phase II capacity restoration to pre-overflow levels.
